item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Uses `dspy.ChatAdapter().format(...)` directly on demos and inputs, and never calls an LM."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Creates an incomplete demo with one input (`passage`) and one output (`answer`), matching the kept-incomplete-demo condition."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Prints the formatted `messages` and asserts the incomplete demo user message contains `some input or output fields are not supplied`."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Asserts the incomplete demo assistant message contains `Not supplied for this particular example.`, showing an explicit placeholder rather than an empty string."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Also asserts later messages contain complete-demo values like `Another passage.` and `line 1`, confirming the complete demo is retained too."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
